_comment: MiniMax. The API-key Connections speak Chat Completions, the subscription Connection speaks Anthropic Messages. temperature must lie in (0, 1]. M2.x reasons on every request and takes no reasoning control; Chat asks for the trace as reasoning_details (reasoning_split). M3 on Chat toggles adaptive thinking. The Messages wire takes no Claude thinking controls and no media and replays only signed thinking blocks (the Messages default meta_only).

rules.note: M3 switches thinking between adaptive and disabled; no effort level or budget reaches the wire.
